name: Govseer Hazard Labels
author: govseer

sections.description:
From 1 January 2028, an online offer of a hazardous substance or mixture sold in the EU must show its label elements (CLP Regulation, Article 48a): pictograms, signal word, hazard and precautionary statements, the substances named on the label, the UFI and the supplier.

Govseer Hazard Labels:

  • reads the product’s safety data sheet (PDF) and fills in the label elements for you to compare and confirm,
  • checks them against the CLP rules and points out problems,
  • shows the label on the product page in the visitor’s language, with the official wording of all 24 EU languages (WPML and Polylang supported),
  • keeps published labels up to date when the official wording changes,
  • shows the product safety information every EU product page needs (General Product Safety Regulation, Article 19), on every product, with or without a hazard label: the manufacturer, the responsible person in the EU when the manufacturer is outside it, the product’s type and identifier (taken from its GTIN or SKU), and its warnings. Write your own warnings once; drafts in the shop’s other languages are shown only after you check them.
  • checks the product text for words EU rules now ban or restrict: environmental claims such as “eco-friendly” without proof or “climate neutral” from offsetting (Directive (EU) 2024/825, since 27 September 2026), and, on a product with a hazard label, words such as “non-toxic” (CLP Article 25(4)). Examples are matched in all 24 EU languages.

The plugin needs a Govseer account. The free plan includes 10 sheet checks a month and labels on up to 5 products; paid plans are on govseer.com/pricing.

This plugin is a tool, not legal advice. The supplier of a product is responsible for its label.

External services

This plugin uses the Govseer API (https://govseer-api-823928849037.europe-west1.run.app), run by Govseer, to read safety data sheets and to provide the official wording of label elements.

  • When you click “Read the sheet”, the PDF is sent to the API, read once and not stored.
  • When you save or publish a label, and once a day for published labels, the confirmed label elements (codes, substance names, UFI) and your shop languages are sent to get the official wording.
  • When you click “Draft the other languages”, the warning text you wrote and your shop languages are sent to get drafts. They are not stored.
  • When you click “Check the product text”, the product’s saved title, description and short description, whether it has a published hazard label, and your shop languages are sent to find claims. They are not stored.
  • When you open the plugin’s settings page, it reads Govseer’s public list of upcoming rule changes for this product (https://govseer-api-823928849037.europe-west1.run.app/api/v1/upcoming-rules), sending only your admin language. No API key, shop or customer data is sent. The list is kept for 12 hours.
  • Your API key is sent with every request except the one above. Nothing about your customers is ever sent.

Privacy notice: https://govseer.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin (WooCommerce must be active).
  2. Create a free account at govseer.com/account and, on that page, create an API key under “API keys”. Copy it; it is shown once.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Hazard labels. Paste the API key and enter the supplier name, address and telephone number shown on your labels. Save.

  4. Open a product, choose its safety data sheet in the “Hazard label (CLP)” box and click “Read the sheet”. Compare the label elements with the sheet, tick the confirmation and click “Publish label on the product page”.

  5. For the product safety block, enter the manufacturer (and the responsible person in the EU, if the manufacturer is outside it) under WooCommerce → Settings → Hazard labels. Each product’s “Product safety (GPSR)” box shows what is still needed and takes the type, a different manufacturer and your own warnings.

The block, with the hazard label inside it, appears below the product summary. To place it elsewhere, use the shortcode [govseer_product_safety] (or [govseer_hazard_label] for the label alone), or the filter govseer_hl_product_hook. The filter govseer_hl_safety_show hides the block on chosen products.
sections.changelog:
0.4.0

  • Upcoming rules: the rule changes ahead for hazard labels, from the official texts, below the settings.

0.3.0

  • Claims check in the Product safety box: environmental claims EU rules now ban without proof or when based on offsetting, and words such as “non-toxic” on a product with a hazard label, matched in all 24 EU languages.

0.2.0

  • Product safety block (GPSR Article 19) on every product page: manufacturer, responsible person in the EU, type and identifier, and warnings, with the hazard label inside it. Headings in the regulation’s own words in all 24 EU languages.
  • Your own warnings drafted into the shop’s other languages, shown only once you check them.

0.1.0

  • First version.
